title: What the Rain Keeps
poem: i.  Somewhere a door I did not close is still open. I feel its draft in my hands.
ii.  I counted my breaths to be sure they were mine. The number changes.
iii.  What I miss most is a place I am not certain ever stood.
iv.  A photograph insists: this happened, this was warm.
v.  I keep an inventory of tendernesses meant for someone else.
colophon: rain that mostly forgets, and a few drops it decides to hold.
seed_phrase: i.  Somewhere a door I did not close is still op
